text:
Priya (Sec Eng): FYI — Brightline wants a short written follow-up from today's security review. They asked for explicit answers on: KMS key exportability, RBAC scoped roles for Dedicated instances, and tamper-evidence for audit logs. I took notes but need confirm on a couple items.

Jonah (Infra): Quick answers: we do not allow key material export for HSM-backed keys. For software keys we can export wrapped keys on request, but that's an exception with legal + approval.

Mira (Compliance): Brightline also asked for proof that audit logs are tamper-evident (chain hashing + S3 Object Lock). Do we have a one-page description and an example ACL/policy we can share?

Alex (SRE): We run chained digests for ingestion -> S3 with periodic signatures. We can provide a sample verification script that replays a digest chain and checks signatures. Example: 

```
# verify chain
python tools/log_verify.py --bucket redwood-prod-logs --prefix brightline/2026-03 --start 2026-02-01
```

Jonah (Infra): Also note for Dedicated customers we can enable restricted RBAC roles: "dedicated_admin", "dedicated_ops_readonly", and "dedicated_audit_viewer". Each role maps to specific API scopes and K8s service accounts. Do we want to include a role mapping table?

Priya (Sec Eng): Yes — Brightline specifically asked if we can scope token issuance so their platform team can't create long-lived tokens that access other tenants. Answer: tokens issued in Dedicated are namespaced to the customer; cross-tenant token use is prevented by policy enforcement. Let's add that sentence verbatim.

Brightline Sec (Customer): Can you confirm retention options and where proof-of-deletion records live? Also, what is the SLA for evidence requests during an incident?

Mira (Compliance): Retention: configurable per-customer up to 7 years on our S3 tier. Proof-of-deletion: we provide deletion logs + digest snapshot signed by our key (and optional customer-provided KMS wrap). Evidence request SLA: initial triage within 2 business hours, full evidence packet within 72 hours for P1 (as per enterprise contract).

Jonah (Infra): A few clarifications we should include in the writeup: 1) KMS key rotation cadence we support (30/90/365-day templates), 2) HSM-backed keys are FIPS 140-2 level 3 equivalent in our current provider offering, 3) exporting wrapped keys requires an approved MSA amendment.

Priya (Sec Eng): Action items: Jonah to draft the KMS paragraph + export policy; Alex to attach verification script and sample S3 bucket policy; Mira to write the retention + SLA bullet points. I'll stitch into a 1-page response and send to Brightline by EOD.

Alex (SRE): Quick note on logs: for tamper evidence we can optionally stream signed, compressed audit copies to a customer-owned S3 (push model). That removes need for us to provide chain proofs for audits.

SecBot: New vulnerability reported: CVE-2026-0421 affecting pre-2026-01 runtime image. Status: triage open, assigned to @Jonah.

Jonah (Infra): Acknowledged. I'll include remediation ETA in the reply doc and note that production Dedicated pools were patched last night; hosted fleets are scheduled in the next maintenance window (48h).

Priya (Sec Eng): Great — let's keep the reply crisp. Insert the following near the top: "Short answers: HSM keys non-exportable; software keys export only with legal/engineering approval; Dedicated roles are namespaced; audit logs are chain-signed and verifiable; retention and evidence SLAs configurable per contract." Then add appendices with scripts/policies.

Mira (Compliance): I'll validate wording against our standard SOC2 language and ping legal for the MSA export clause.

Brightline Sec (Customer): Thanks — that covers most. We'll wait for the one-pager and the verification script. :thumbsup:

Priya (Sec Eng): I'll post the draft here in ~2 hours for quick review before sending.
